body: Build 0087. The Retrograde arc begins. Return to Paris for retroactive FAREWELL audit of departure sites. A-278 Île Saint-Louis re-measurement: REFUSAL (18ft, 1931, pre-awareness) AND FAREWELL-B (11ft, unconscious, subject told himself he would return). FINDING: REFUSAL and FAREWELL are distinct constructions; they can coexist at the same site. FAREWELL taxonomy established: FAREWELL-A (conscious departure, A-355, 30+ft) vs FAREWELL-B (unconscious departure, A-278, 11ft). 73 candidate departure sites across 355-site archive (21%). Amsterdam–Paris 1789 connection: Dutch Patriots in exile; Tyler followed argument to Paris; A-P14 Bastille (UNINTENTIONAL) in context. Tyler: 'More than I want to count' — second use, unprompted. Camera Op chooses to film the river, not Tyler. RSI receipts: Eastwind TYLER-071 (Footnote #75), Camera Op Entry 64, Jiangshi Memo #051, VC-001 Days 359–368, EMILY-SPRING-040.
title: TYLER S08E05 — The Retrograde I (Paris)
